modeSheet.text: Đóng Chế độ Ngày mệt sau cuộc nhậu chỉ hôm nay Món thanh nhẹ (món hầm, món hấp, món nước…) sẽ ra nhiều hơn. Món chiên, món béo và món quá cay sẽ ít ra hơn (không bị bỏ đi). Ngày mai trở lại như cũ. Chế độ ăn kiêng gợi ý món có calo ước tính thấp hơn thường xuyên hơn Ít tinh bột Bữa ăn ít cơm, mì và khoai, nhiều món rau và món đạm hơn. Hiển thị ước tính carbohydrate (g) mỗi người Giảm muối hiện mức mặn ước chừng Sau ca đêm hiện mục bữa sáng vào mọi giờ Thực đơn hiện tại không đổi. Nhấn “Thực đơn mới”, hoặc nhấn vào món rồi “Đổi”, để chọn lại.

why.name: 滷花生
why.seasBase: 3 tbsp soy sauce · 1 tbsp rock sugar · 1 star anise · 1/2 tsp salt · 800 ml water
stepsBase: Rinse the peanuts and soak them for 2 hours (or overnight).
Put them in a pot with the water, star anise, soy sauce, rock sugar and salt.
Bring to a boil and simmer on low heat for about 1 hour, until soft but not mushy.
Turn off the heat and let them sit in the liquid to absorb the flavour. Serve warm or cold.
why.seas: 醬油 3大匙 · 冰糖 1大匙 · 八角 1顆 · 鹽 1/2小匙 · 水 800毫升
steps: 花生洗淨，泡水2小時（或一晚）。
花生放入鍋中，加水、八角、醬油、冰糖和鹽。
煮滾後轉小火滷約1小時，滷到軟而不爛。
關火後泡在滷汁裡入味。熱吃冷吃都可以。

why.name: 滷花生
why.seasBase: 3 tbsp soy sauce · 1 tbsp rock sugar · 1 star anise · 1/2 tsp salt · 800 ml water
stepsBase: Rinse the peanuts and soak them for 2 hours (or overnight).
Put them in a pot with the water, star anise, soy sauce, rock sugar and salt.
Bring to a boil and simmer on low heat for about 1 hour, until soft but not mushy.
Turn off the heat and let them sit in the liquid to absorb the flavour. Serve warm or cold.
why.seas: 醬油 3大匙 · 冰糖 1大匙 · 八角 1顆 · 鹽 1/2小匙 · 水 800毫升
steps: 花生洗淨，泡水2小時（或一晚）。
花生放入鍋中，加水、八角、醬油、冰糖和鹽。
煮滾後轉小火滷約1小時，滷到軟而不爛。
關火後泡在滷汁裡入味。熱吃冷吃都可以。

tip.why: 滷花生是台式清粥小菜的經典
tip.how: 泡過的花生熟得均勻，口感鬆軟綿密。

why.name: Rempeyek kacang
why.seasBase: 2 tbsp tapioca starch · 3 garlic cloves · 3 candlenuts · 1 tsp coriander seed · 1 cm kencur · 2 lime leaves, finely sliced · 1 tsp salt · 250 ml thin coconut milk or water · oil for frying
stepsBase: Grind the garlic, candlenuts, coriander, kencur and salt. Mix with the rice flour, tapioca and coconut milk into a runny batter; stir in the lime leaves and peanuts.
Ladle a thin layer of batter onto the side of a wok of hot oil (or into a small pan with a little oil), splash oil over it until it sets, then slide it into the oil.
Fry on medium heat for 3-4 minutes until crisp and pale golden. Drain well and keep in an airtight jar.
why.seas: 2 sdm tepung tapioka · 3 siung bawang putih · 3 butir kemiri · 1 sdt ketumbar · kencur 1 cm · 2 lembar daun jeruk, iris halus · 1 sdt garam · 250 ml santan encer atau air · minyak untuk menggoreng
steps: Haluskan bawang putih, kemiri, ketumbar, kencur, dan garam. Campur dengan tepung beras, tapioka, dan santan menjadi adonan encer; masukkan daun jeruk dan kacang.
Tuang tipis adonan dengan sendok sayur di dinding wajan berisi minyak panas (atau ke wajan kecil dengan sedikit minyak), siram minyak sampai set, lalu dorong ke dalam minyak.
Goreng dengan api sedang 3-4 menit sampai renyah dan kuning keemasan. Tiriskan dan simpan dalam toples kedap udara.

why.seasBase: 5 shallots · 3 garlic cloves · 3 candlenuts · 2 cm turmeric · 2 cm ginger · 1 tsp coriander seed · 1 lemongrass stalk · 2 cm galangal · 3 kaffir lime leaves · 2 salam leaves · 1 tsp palm sugar · 1.5 tsp salt · 2 tbsp oil · 1.2 litres water
stepsBase: Simmer the beef whole in the water on low heat for 60 minutes, skimming, until tender. Lift it out, cut into 2 cm cubes and keep the broth.
Crack the keluak shells and scoop out the black flesh; discard any that smells sour or mouldy. Soak the flesh in 3 tbsp hot water for 10 minutes.

Blend the keluak with the shallots, garlic, candlenuts, turmeric, ginger and coriander. Fry in the oil over medium heat with the bruised lemongrass and galangal, lime leaves and salam for 5 minutes, until dark and fragrant.
Stir the paste and the beef into the broth, season with palm sugar and salt and simmer 30 minutes so the flavour soaks in.
Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water for 30 seconds. Serve the rawon over rice with the sprouts, halved salted egg, sambal and krupuk.
why.seas: 5 butir bawang merah · 3 siung bawang putih · 3 butir kemiri · kunyit 2 cm · jahe 2 cm · 1 sdt ketumbar · 1 batang serai · lengkuas 2 cm · 3 lembar daun jeruk · 2 lembar daun salam · 1 sdt gula merah · 1,5 sdt garam · 2 sdm minyak · 1,2 liter air
steps: Rebus daging utuh dalam air dengan api kecil selama 60 menit sambil dibuang busanya sampai empuk. Angkat, potong dadu 2 cm, dan simpan kaldunya.
Pecahkan kluwek dan keruk isinya yang hitam; buang yang berbau asam atau berjamur. Rendam isinya dalam 3 sdm air panas selama 10 menit.

Haluskan kluwek bersama bawang merah, bawang putih, kemiri, kunyit, jahe, dan ketumbar. Tumis dengan minyak di api sedang bersama serai dan lengkuas yang dimemarkan, daun jeruk, dan daun salam selama 5 menit sampai hitam pekat dan harum.
Masukkan bumbu dan daging ke kaldu, beri gula merah dan garam, lalu masak 30 menit agar bumbu meresap.
Seduh tauge dengan air mendidih 30 detik. Sajikan rawon dengan nasi, tauge, telur asin yang dibelah, sambal, dan kerupuk.

tip.add: Sesendok sambal terasi dan kerupuk udang
tip.how: Kluwek yang berat dan tidak berbunyi saat diguncang isinya masih lembap; isinya hitam mengilap dan berbau gurih, bukan asam.

why.name: Toad in the hole
why.seasBase: 3 tbsp sunflower oil or beef dripping · 1 tsp wholegrain mustard · 1/2 tsp dried sage · Salt · Pepper
stepsBase: Whisk the flour, eggs, mustard and a pinch of salt, then gradually whisk in the milk to a smooth batter like single cream. Rest at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the sausages, the onion cut into wedges and the oil in a roasting tin (about 20 x 30 cm) and roast 15 minutes.
Make sure the fat is sizzling hot, then quickly pour the batter around the sausages and scatter over the sage.
Bake 25-30 minutes without opening the door, until the batter is risen, crisp and deep golden. Serve straight away with onion gravy.
why.seas: 3 tbsp sunflower oil or beef dripping · 1 tsp wholegrain mustard · 1/2 tsp dried sage · Salt · Pepper
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, mustard and a pinch of salt, then gradually whisk in the milk to a smooth batter like single cream. Rest at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the sausages, the onion cut into wedges and the oil in a roasting tin (about 20 x 30 cm) and roast 15 minutes.
Make sure the fat is sizzling hot, then quickly pour the batter around the sausages and scatter over the sage.
Bake 25-30 minutes without opening the door, until the batter is risen, crisp and deep golden. Serve straight away with onion gravy.

tip.why: The crisp batter loves lots of gravy
tip.how: Batter poured into sizzling fat puffs up at once; if the fat is only warm it stays flat and stodgy.

Ipinapakita ang tantiyang carbohydrates (g) bawat tao Kapag naka-on, unang imumungkahi ang mga ulam na mas kaunti ang carbohydrates; mamaya na ang mga ulam na kanin, noodles at maraming patatas, mga matamis na nilaga, mga pritong makapal ang balot at mga sabaw na may patatas, sotanghon o noodles (walang tinatanggal, at hindi binabago ang napagpasyahang pagkain).
